source-parity.source: GOB 20 supplies max health and typed resistances to the selected owned simulacrum. The shipped combat_calculations.GetDamageReductionValue supplies the armor and level curve used by retaliation.
source-parity.runtime: CoderPets keeps the existing raw melee retaliation, which already accounts for the attacker/pet level relationship, and applies the armor contribution relative to the zero-rating baseline. Fortify removes its max-HP and resistance contributions on expiry without refilling current HP.
source-parity.test: [Native PR819](https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/819#issuecomment-7086307822) verified 30 IS, a two-second cast, eight-second reuse, +36 resistance and max HP 224→494→224. Against the same level-4 attacker, raw/final pairs included 11/11 unbuffed, 9/6 and 11/7 fortified, then 10/10 after expiry. The fixture advances the timer to its normal expiry path and the existing rank and retaliation tests bracket the level interaction.
